rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the sound or instance of a sudden intake of breath.

example.english: When they heard the doctor say there would be an injection, they let out a gasp.
example.traditional: 聽到醫生話要打針，佢即刻發出一聲抽氣聲。
example.jyutping: ting1 dou3 ji1 sang1 waa6 jiu3 daa2 zam1 keoi5 zik1 hak1 faat3 ceot1 jat1 sing1 cau1 hei3 sing1
